definition.en: The current ten-year layer places its Life role over this natal domain, marking sustained structural emphasis without predicting an event.
definition.zh-Hans: 当前十年层把大限命宫角色叠加到这一先天领域，表示持续的结构强调，不预测具体事件。

definition.en: The current annual layer places its Life role over this natal domain, marking current domain focus without predicting an outcome.
definition.zh-Hans: 当前年度层把流年命宫角色叠加到这一先天领域，表示当年的领域焦点，不预测结果。

definition.en: Long-period and annual Life roles occupy the same natal domain. This is an observed structural overlap, not evidence that an event must occur.
definition.zh-Hans: 大限与流年命宫角色落在同一先天领域。这只是结构叠加观察，不代表某个事件必然发生。

definition.en: This dynamic layer marks the target star with Hua Lu, used here only as a structural resource or flow signal.
definition.zh-Hans: 这一动态层对目标星曜标记化禄，本系统仅将其作为资源或流动的结构讯号。

definition.en: This dynamic layer marks the target star with Hua Quan, used here as mobilization or influence pressure rather than a status prediction.
definition.zh-Hans: 这一动态层对目标星曜标记化权，本系统将其视为动员或影响压力，而非地位预测。

definition.en: This dynamic layer marks the target star with Hua Ke, used here as visibility, ordering or clarification structure rather than promised recognition.
definition.zh-Hans: 这一动态层对目标星曜标记化科，本系统将其视为可见性、秩序或澄清结构，而非保证获得认可。

definition.en: This dynamic layer marks the target star with Hua Ji, used here as friction, constraint or unfinished attention rather than a negative-event forecast.
definition.zh-Hans: 这一动态层对目标星曜标记化忌，本系统将其视为摩擦、约束或未完成注意力，而非负面事件预测。
